mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in year-over-year growth of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending momentum that directly supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth is positive, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), positive year-over-year growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals tight labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins through productivity gains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals manufacturing contraction alongside housing market recovery, indicating balanced economic growth that reduces equity volatility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and HOUST increases, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of housing starts (HOUST) exceeds 10%, it signals strong housing market momentum that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST 12m growth exceeds 10%, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers corporate discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month average of FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, it signals monetary policy tightening that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS 3m average exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC over last 3 years falls below 0.03.
